weightLossConsult.whyMatch: Our weight loss programs include weekly GLP-1 medication, personalized dosing, and ongoing RN support. We'll help you find the right fit.

whyMatch.hangover: Based on your symptoms, the Hangover IV delivers fast rehydration with anti-nausea and pain medication to get you back on your feet in under an hour.
whyMatch.migraine: Our Migraine IV uses triple-dose magnesium -- clinically shown to block migraine pain pathways -- plus Toradol and Zofran for fast, targeted relief.
whyMatch.immunity: This immune-boosting IV floods your system with high-dose Vitamin C, Zinc, and Glutathione to help your body fight off what's coming.
whyMatch.hydration: Pure saline rehydration restores your body's fluid balance fast. Most people feel noticeably better within 30 minutes.
whyMatch.altitude: Colorado's elevation hits hard. This IV rehydrates you while anti-nausea medication tackles the dizziness and headache.
whyMatch.myers: The Myers' Cocktail is the gold standard vitamin IV -- a proven blend of B vitamins, Vitamin C, Magnesium, and Glutathione for overall energy and wellness.
whyMatch.revival: Our most comprehensive IV combines a full vitamin stack with your choice of 3 medications, tailored to help you recover from whatever you're dealing with.
whyMatch.performance: Amino acids, NAD+, and essential nutrients help your muscles recover faster and reduce soreness so you can get back to training.
whyMatch.longevity: NAD+ activates your longevity genes (sirtuins) and supports DNA repair. Combined with a full vitamin stack, this is cellular-level anti-aging.
whyMatch.nad250: NAD+ is a coenzyme in every cell of your body. At 250mg, this infusion restores cellular energy production and clears brain fog from the inside out.
whyMatch.semaglutide: Semaglutide is a GLP-1 medication clinically shown to reduce body weight by up to 15%. Our program includes weekly injections, personalized dosing, and ongoing RN support.
whyMatch.tirzepatide: Tirzepatide works on two hormones (GLP-1 and GIP) for even stronger appetite suppression -- clinical trials show up to 20% body weight reduction.
whyMatch.lipoShots: Lipotropic injections support your liver's fat-processing pathways and boost energy during caloric restriction. A great complement to any weight loss program.
whyMatch.labGeneral: A quick at-home blood draw covering your essential health markers -- CBC, metabolic panel, and cholesterol. Results in days.
whyMatch.labInDepth: Goes deeper than the basics with thyroid (TSH) and blood sugar (HbA1c) markers for a more complete picture of your health.
whyMatch.labVitamin: Checks the specific vitamins and minerals that drive energy and wellness -- B12, Vitamin D, Iron, Magnesium, and more. Know exactly what you need.
whyMatch.labComplete: Our most comprehensive panel with 45+ biomarkers including hormones, metabolic markers, and cardiovascular risk factors. The full picture.
whyMatch.pregnancy: Safe, nurse-administered prenatal hydration and nutrients to support you and your baby through nausea, fatigue, and dehydration.
